about_pullquote: We fix cars the right way, not the expensive way.
about_para_1: CA Units has been keeping Leicester vehicles on the road for over 12 years. We started on a simple principle: diagnose properly, price fairly, and get the job done right first time. From our workshop at Elms Farm Industrial Estate, we've built a reputation for honest, no-nonsense auto electrical work that customers trust and recommend.
about_para_2: Whether you're facing a dead battery on a freezing morning or a mysterious electrical fault that's baffled the forecourt, we get to the root cause fast. Our team invests in the latest diagnostic kit and keeps stocks of common electrical units to avoid unnecessary delays. Repeat customers make up 60% of our work — that's what honest pricing and reliable results build.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Drivers Say About CA Units

reviews.text: Car wouldn't start and I was convinced it was the battery. Turned out to be the alternator. The lads diagnosed it in ten minutes and had a replacement unit on within the hour. Cost me a fraction of what the main dealer quoted. Top service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using CA Units for years now. They're always honest about what needs doing and what doesn't. Last month my lights were playing up — they could've charged me for a full rewire but instead fixed a dodgy connection for a tenner. Can't ask fairer than that.
reviews.author: Paul W.

reviews.text: Needed a new battery and some work on the caravan. Rang them up and they fitted me in the same afternoon. Professional, quick, and the price was spot on. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Janet L.
